competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease the Attack Bar by 20% with a 50% chance. If the Attack Bar was not decreased, increases the Attack Bar of the ally with the highest Attack Bar by 10%.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: If the Attack Bar was not decreased, of the ally with the highest Attack Bar.

competences.description: Removes 1 harmful effect on all allies and recovers their HP by 20%. In addition, increases the Attack Bar of all allies by 15% if no harmful effects were removed.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: if no harmful effects were removed

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 3 times to block them from removing harmful effects for 1 turn. If the total damage enemies received during battle is greater than or equal to that of the allies, each hit decreases their Defense and Attack Speed for 2 turns. Otherwise, each hit leaves a Branding effect and grants Silence for 2 turns.

effets.description: All beneficial effects will be blocked
The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
effets.note: If enemies have received more damage than allies

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
effets.note: If enemies have received more damage than allies

effets.description: The target will receive 25% increased damage.
effets.note: If allies have received more damage than enemies

effets.description: Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)
effets.note: If allies have received more damage than enemies
